ButtonComponent
components.templateData:
<button
  [type]="type()"
  [disabled]="disabled()"
  [attr.aria-label]="ariaLabel()"
  (click)="onClick($event)"
  class="
    inline-flex items-center justify-center font-base font-semibold
    leading-[1.5] transition-colors rounded-md
    focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent
    whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 border-2 border-solid cursor-pointer
    border-primary active:shadow-none
    disabled:bg-primary-muted disabled:border-primary-muted disabled:text-text-disabled
    disabled:shadow-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed
  "
  [class]="buttonClasses()"
>
  <ng-content />
</button>
